tenures.note: Dated from the fed's own record of the cards it appears on (5 shows, every kind of appearance counted). Joined to this record on the card's own evidence: An invented two-word name, and Other Feds ('TWWL, Spinebuster Wrestling, BRAND Wrestling') naming BRAND Wrestling, whose roster row this record is (2008). The card's nickname 'the Prince of Pinfall' is also the aka of ikan-jobtayoo-igc, a museum-side merge not filed here.
